How we dial in espresso every morning ⚙️

It’s not just about the grind. Watch our head barista @jake_brews walk through the full process:

1. Weigh dose (18.5g)
2. Distribute & tamp
3. Pull shot (target 36g in 28s)
4. Taste & adjust

We do this EVERY morning before opening. Consistency is everything.

AeroPress recipe that slaps 👋

Inverted method:
• 15g fine grind
• 200ml water at 85°C
• Stir 10x at 0:30
• Press at 1:30
• Top up with 50ml hot water

Smooth, clean, sweet. Try it this weekend!

How to store your coffee beans properly ☕📦

DO:
✔️ Airtight container
✔️ Cool, dark place
✔️ Use within 4 weeks of roast date
✔️ Buy whole bean, grind fresh

DON’T:
❌ Fridge or freezer (moisture!)
❌ Clear glass jars in sunlight
❌ Pre-ground bulk bags
❌ Near the stove

Save this for reference! 🔖
